title: Ashbury Rewards Engagement Recognition: Dining Uplift by Elite Night Credits (Guest Folios)
content:
The engagement dining uplift of the Ashbury Rewards dining allowance on Guest Folios is an amount per person set by the membership's elite night credits in the year.

**Term.** Engagement dining uplift: a membership with seventy-five (75) or more elite night credits in the current calendar year adds the seventy-five-night uplift of $12.00 per person, a membership with fifty to seventy-four (50 to 74) adds the fifty-night uplift of $6.00 per person, and a membership with fewer adds nothing.

The elite night credits are those shown on the Ashbury Rewards membership credited for the stay: the elite night credits accrued in the current calendar year.

| Elite night credits in the current calendar year | Uplift per person |
|---|---|
| 75 or more | $12.00 |
| 50 to 74 | $6.00 |
| 49 or fewer | None |

## Points of judgement (hypothetical memberships)

- **49 elite night credits.** Fewer than 50: no uplift.
- **50 elite night credits.** At the lower threshold: $6.00 per person.
- **74 elite night credits.** Still below 75: $6.00 per person.
- **75 elite night credits.** At the upper threshold: $12.00 per person.
- **Credits of a previous year.** Only the current calendar year's elite night credits count.
